title: Easy Taco Skillet
description: This quick and delicious taco skillet bake made with beef, rice, cheese, and taco seasoning will keep your family happy and coming back for more.

steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir beef and onion until beef is browned, about 5 minutes. Drain. Stir tomatoes, water, rice, and taco seasoning into beef mixture and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 25 minutes. Top with Mexican cheese blend and lettuce before serving.

video.description: One skillet recipes make cooking for a family wonderfully simple; these recipes are quick and easy, with less to clean up. In this video, learn how to make a flavorful taco skillet that comes together in one pan. This dish was made for hurried weeknight dinners, plus you can even do away with plates by letting people scoop the ingredients out with chips. Coming in at under ten dollars to make, this recipe could easily find a way into your regular rotation.
